title: The Ice Flower on a Frozen Lake
short_teaser: Under certain conditions, delicate crystals can grow across new ice in patterns that resemble petals or ferns.
story: Under certain conditions, delicate crystals can grow across new ice in patterns that resemble petals or ferns. The forms are temporary and highly sensitive to weather. Beauty can be both precise and brief. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
